rationale: Product copy, order, and selected image remain quick-editable in one TABLE. The image filePicker column stores Wallboard's {name, id, location} media reference directly in each row.

behavior.unbound: render bundled synthetic product rows with designed no-image treatments
behavior.invalidRows: skip rows missing sku, name, or category
behavior.assetLookup: read the selected file from Products.image.location and cache it through the platform
behavior.assetFallback: show a color-led product silhouette when an image is empty or fails
behavior.pagination: rotate one product per page and preserve the active product across live data reordering
